extraction_method: Reproduced the 20260902 scrape method: same private JSON API (POST /api/leaderboard {arenaType, category, variationName, inputModality?}; GET /api/leaderboard/judge-scores; POST /api/leaderboard/llm-scores; GET /api/registry) on https://www.designarena.ai/leaderboard. This browser session is shared by six other rescrape agents; select_page->evaluate_script was raced twice (the selection flipped to another agent's page between the two calls, evidenced first by a same-origin relative fetch returning arena.ai's 'Route not allowed' 403, then by an absolute-URL cross-origin fetch throwing 'TypeError: Failed to fetch' because the executing page had been switched away from designarena.ai). Per the contention fallback already documented in the 20260902 meta.json, the full 33-endpoint sweep (32 leaderboard categories + judge-scores + llm-scores + registry) was re-issued from Node fetch in Bash, which was not blocked in this environment despite the task brief. Cross-verified: a browser evaluate_script fetch of models/allcategories (confirmed via location.href==https://www.designarena.ai/leaderboard immediately before the fetch, in the same tool call) returned count=161 with the first record (kimi-k3: wins 3605, losses 1895, battles 5500, winRate 65.5, elo 1398, btStdErr 5.0361, avgGenerationTimeMs 635626) byte-identical to the Node-fetched payload.
notes: raw.json holds untouched API payloads keyed by "<arenaType>/<category>[/<inputModality>]", plus the full /api/registry (model display names, providers, pricing) and the judge-scores / llm-scores payloads.
Elo is the site metric; battles map to votes; winRate is a percentage (0-100). btStdErr is the Bradley-Terry standard error the API returns.
inputModality variants are distinct site leaderboards: models/website/image = Image-to-HTML, models/website/video = Video-to-Website, agents/agon_webapps/image = Image-to-Webapp.

cost_usd is not published as a single number by the site; the registry gives per-1M-token text pricing, emitted as cost_usd_input_per_1m_tokens / cost_usd_output_per_1m_tokens only where present. Nothing blended or estimated.
context_window is not exposed anywhere on the site, so it is omitted from every record.
date is the per-category metadata.lastUpdateTime returned by the API.

Registry categories that returned an empty data array at scrape time (present in raw.json, absent from normalized.json): models/music, models/sts, models/worldmodel, agents/agon_dataviz, agents/agentic_3d, agents/fullstack_gamedev, agents/agon_html

Category ids "imagetohtml" and "videotowebsite" appear in the client bundle but are rejected by the API (400 Invalid category); those pages are the website category with an inputModality filter, which is what was captured.
Only variationName "public" appears in the client code; no other variation was requested.
No login, no voting, no CAPTCHA; nothing was blocked.

Muse Spark 1.3 was NOT found: absent from every one of the 32 leaderboard-category payloads, absent from llm-scores, and absent from the /api/registry model list entirely (only muse-spark-1.2 and muse-image-1.0 exist under the 'muse' family). This contradicts the expectation that it would be present as of this scrape; not fabricated, reported as observed.

Gemini 3.8 Flash (model id gemini-3.8-flash) exists in the /api/registry model list and pricing table (input $0.75 / output $3.75 per 1M tokens, cachedInput $0.075) but has zero leaderboard entries -- it does not appear in any of the 32 category payloads or llm-scores, so it has no elo/rank/votes to report.
changes_vs_20260902: Same 33-key set as 20260902 (32 categories + llm-scores), same total row_count of 1972, and the exact same set of model_id+category keys -- no models were added to or removed from any leaderboard since the last scrape. However 1946 of the 1972 records changed value (elo/votes/wins/losses/date shifted slightly from ~1 more day of voting); Muse Spark 1.2's rows in models/allcategories, models/website and agents/agon_webapps happened to be byte-identical to 20260902. No Muse Spark 1.3 or Gemini 3.8 Flash leaderboard rows appeared.
